title: Dyson PencilVac Fluffycones Cleaner (Matte Black) $479.20 (RRP $849) Delivered @ Dyson
body:
Deal: Dyson PencilVac Fluffycones Cleaner (Matte Black) $479.20 (RRP $849) Delivered @ Dyson

[Hornpub] almost half price? is that MSRP for real?
[ozilicious] No, more like $700.
Design issue, the thin plastic battery housing quickly cracks at the base with normal use.
Replacement batteries are $150 but have been OOS since January and only available for $300 on eBay.
[rzy6cn] If it breaks before warranty ends do they offer free replacement?
[ozilicious] No, only to mail the whole vac in.
They said if they determine it's a manufacturing defect they'd cover costs, otherwise customer's liable to pay for shipping both ways plus repairs.
[rzy6cn] @ozilicious: Not sure why it is out of stock so long in Australia but you are able to get replacement from Japan for around $90 each + shipping.
[rzy6cn] Not sure if it works with shopback 10.5% cashback and 8% apple pay bonus cashback.
[xavster] who would have thought a vacuum cleaner would be a flex one day, 2026 is crazy!
[whichwhatwho] Dyson really just push the limits to how stupid customers will be.
Like, how many ways do we need to suck shit off the ground. It's not an evolution thing. It either does it or it doesn't.
But they have what, 100 SKU's all offering some different wording of doing the same shit
[Switchblade88] Back in the day the first cyclonic vacs were excellent; an order of magnitude more effective than the Sunbeam or Goldair bagged vacs. Engineering made a measureable difference to dust levels. Asthmatics could feel the difference.
Now, all they're doing is chasing consumer dollars and their innovation edge has been lost to Chinese manufacturers. Stupid things like not including balance charging on their lipo cells for deliberate planned obsolecence.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] Apparently this is only a very limited use weak vacuum cleaner. Only for hard floors, no carpet. Small dust bin. Very small and niche. Maybe this is the vacuum cleaner you buy when you already have regular professional cleaners and live in a small flat with hard floors.
